svg.title: A narrowing gap can widen again

cc:Work.dc:title: A narrowing gap can widen again
cc:Work.dc:description: OpenSLR-83 gap by actual model-release date. Lines connect distinct systems in chronological order, not generations of one product. Overall Spearman rho −0.75, p<0.05. Last four gaps: 0.7, 5.1, 5.4, 8.5 percentage points. Source: saved trend score aggregates, as in Figure 1.
